items.name: LogtoResource
items.description: Represents a containerized resource specific to Logto that extends the base functionality of container resources by providing additional endpoint and connection string management.
items.remarks:
This class is designed for use in an application hosting environment and incorporates
a primary HTTP endpoint with predefined default port configurations.
